instruction:
Task: Read the user's exact Chinese script aloud once, without adding, omitting, or paraphrasing any words. Do not read these instructions.
Language: Mandarin Chinese only, from beginning to end.
Voice and delivery: A clearly masculine adult male tech host, medium-to-low speaking register, conversational and curious, like talking to a friend. Do not adopt a feminine, breathy or theatrical voice. Keep the voice identity stable throughout.
Pacing: Brisk, fluent, around 5.5 Chinese syllables per second. Keep pauses short and natural. Read the introduction and the following discussion at one consistent pace; do not slow down or reset after the show title. Use natural Mandarin tones and question intonation. Keep every syllable clear.
Proper names: 咕仔 is gū zǎi. 捅咕捅咕 is tǒng gu tǒng gu, with light neutral-tone gu. Speak the text only.
Accent: Standard mainland Putonghua. Native, clear, neutral Standard Mandarin consonants and vowels; distinguish zh/ch/sh from z/c/s. No heavy regional coloration or exaggerated erhua. Keep this accent stable from the first word to the last.

approved_reference.script: 我是咕仔，这里是让我捅咕捅咕。今天我们聊聊，人工智能到底改变了什么？查资料、写文章、做内容，答案来得越来越快。可真正值得花时间的，是想清楚：哪些事可以交给工具，哪些判断，还得自己来。
